structure.layout: single-column dark landing page doubling as the app: floating pill nav, centered hero with live send widget, then 1024px-wide stacked sections each with mono eyebrow + left heading / right intro two-column header, separated by hairline rules, and multi-column footer

aesthetics.typography: Geist (sans) for wordmark, headings, body, nav and buttons; Geist Mono for uppercase letter-spaced eyebrows/labels (SEND, READY, HOW IT WORKS, footer column titles), tab labels, command snippets, terminal, stats counter and microcopy
aesthetics.typeScale: Extreme contrast: 128px/800 hero wordmark; 36px/600 section H2s; 16-18px body/intro; 14-15px UI text; 10-13px mono uppercase tracked labels

notes: Near-black monochrome UI with only a green status dot and a pale-blue mono eyebrow as color. Fully-rounded pill nav and white pill CTAs contrast with 14px-radius panels and square hairline grids (mixed shapes). Section headers consistently: tiny letter-spaced mono eyebrow, 2-line 36px H2 left, gray intro paragraph right. Lots of mono 'spec sheet' details: key-value rows with hairline dividers, ✕/→ bulleted lists, fake terminal transcript with ASCII progress bars, desktop app window mockup. Hero wordmark has a faint dark glow behind it. Nav is sticky with scroll-spy active pill. Install command has copy button. Style summary reports #ffffff background but rendered page is near-black; palette hex values estimated from screenshot.
